envHints.REDIS_URL: Auto-injected by Railway Redis plugin (Hobby tier).
envHints.DATABASE_URL: Auto-injected by Railway Postgres plugin (Hobby tier). Normalized to postgresql+asyncpg://... by db/__init__.py.
envHints.WS_MAX_CONCURRENT: Override default 30 concurrent WS limit. Single-replica in-memory tracker.
envHints.BUDGET_USD_DAILY: Anthropic spend cap (default 50). Halts new debates at 80% utilization.
envHints.BUDGET_HALT_FRACTION: Fraction of cap that triggers halt (default 0.80).
